# Charged occurrence layouts for the retained complex compiler

This gives one source-compatible choice of layouts, not literal equality to
an existing final executable. It is a geometry theorem conditional on the retained native endpoint,
whole-job monomial, owned-erasure and compact-primitive contracts. It constructs
coordinate maps; it does not assume that an injection is a free machine action.
It does not implement numerical children, prove rounded endpoints, produce the
final dispatcher or discharge any of the five selected assumptions. The selected
result remains #6030, kappa = 781451/250000000.

## 1. Source boundary and the raw 265/145 distinction

The selected review preserves the preceding caller's phase, Laurent, routing,
target and chronology equations. Its controller is the pinned
`p104-productive-controller/CONTROLLER.json`. Its LOCAL stages are

    S = {0, 1, 3, 5, ..., 31, 32}.

There are 18 stages. Define the ordered retained coordinate set

    E = {0,...,8} union {9+8(s-1)+i : s in S minus {0}, 0<=i<8}.

Thus |E|=9+17*8=145 inside the audit's 265-coordinate address space.
Every LOCAL fresh route changes only the base nine coordinates and its own
fresh block; every query translation is in the base nine. Every actual IDLE
and every final diagonal uses only stages in S. Scalar field operations have
no address action. Helper native maps act on the base nine coordinates before
their stage route. These facts follow directly from the controller lists and
the named route formulas; the verifier binds the complete lists. They concern
physical operations. Intermediate chart expressions such as `completed(stage)`
may mention unused stages, but the contact identity reduces the physical
boundary to the local route and its translation. We retain that audited
contact identity rather than deleting terms from a chart expression.

Let c:E -> {0,...,144} be increasing enumeration. A raw local binary map or
translation supported on E restricts under c, with every discarded coordinate
an arbitrary spectator. Its scalar phase and quadratic phase polynomial are
unchanged under this injective renaming; neither a phase nor a spectator is
set to zero. The source explicitly authorizes deleting unused fresh spectator
axes by injective relabeling (productive-controller proof, section 3).

Whole-job canonicalizers require a different construction: the audit's complete
265-coordinate `axis_order` need not preserve E. It cannot in general be
restricted as a permutation. Re-emit it on E. For the ordered positive axes A
of a main or IDLE job, retain the same base-nine orthogonal map, then list the
selected coordinate positions followed by every unselected position of E in
increasing order. This is a complete 145-coordinate permutation. Its first
rank columns are exactly c(A); the rest are a full orthogonal complement.
Use the source's appropriate pre/post direction around the complete job.
Gaussian conjugation sends the canonical first-rank job to the positive job
on A and fixes its complement. Binary permutations and the base-nine linear
address map have no extra scalar phase. Retain the separate central translation.
Hence this replacement has the same normalized job endpoint. Equality of old
and new intermediate spectator permutations is neither required nor asserted.

This resolves 265 versus 145 constructively; it is not a counterexample to the
caller. Local helper endpoints and contact identities remain native premises;
this package does not recheck all selected native tasks.

## 2. Charged extension lemma

Fix a selected bit position rho with 0<=rho<K. Work in a complete rectangle
of N coordinate blocks; at multiplicity f each block consists of the f bits
at position rho in f consecutive K-bit chunks. All other chunk bits are
spectators. Let A=(a_0,...,a_(r-1)) be an
ordered list of distinct members of {0,...,N-1}, with r<=h<=N. Define

    order(A,N) = A followed by the increasing list of its complement.

The first h entries give a deterministic injection of an h-coordinate unit
whose first r target coordinates must land on A. The full list is a
permutation, not a projection. Route input records so canonical position i
contains the former coordinate at order(A,N)[i]. Execute the h-coordinate
unit on the first h positions with the rest present as complete spectators.
Inverse-route on return. A unit with endpoint G_r tensor I has endpoint
G_A tensor I in the original rectangle. This is valid for arbitrary data and
arbitrary correlations with parked fields.

A permutation of N blocks is at most N-1 swaps. Each swap is three selected-bit
additions on the f bits at fixed rho, preserving every unselected bit. Reversing
the swaps gives the literal inverse. This is not a swap of whole K-bit chunks.
An entry/return pair at fixed rho costs at most 6(N-1) movement records, in
addition to the unit's own adapters, phase/scalar records and descriptor,
parking and row work. The permutation is fixed before f varies; we do not
enumerate N*f columns. Applying all K bit planes requires its actual K calls;
no K-independent whole-chunk tariff is asserted. Nontrivial binary monomials have separate row-elimination
and phase recipes, not the coordinate-permutation price.

Descriptors contain N,h,A, the ordered complement or its deterministic generator,
the parent order and exact inverse return word. These are finite constants
once the template is fixed. A nested child pushes its descriptor and restores
the parent's before continuation. This proof is conjugation by a bijection;
rank equality alone is not treated as an adapter.

## 3. Composition for the source wrapper grammar

The grammar is `p7-TENSOR` sections 1--3 and `FINITE-PRECOMPILATION` sections
3--6. Each raw endpoint and paid job has its source whole-job monomial
normalizers. Section 1 supplies raw ambient 145. Each owned field is a complete
ambient rectangle tagged by its full occurrence path; the conservative
allocation supplies the complete local owned-bank inventory separately for
every unit occurrence, with no live ancestor reuse. For the selected local
word one may conservatively give each of its 31 owned lifetimes a distinct
field; the proven peak-13 reuse needs its own retained lifetime premise. O
counts every such field, not one field per unit.
Owned initialization, erasure and lockstep ownership remain premises.

**Chronological product.** For U of ambient m and V of ambient n use the m*n
rectangle (a,b). For V role j of target rank h_j, embed its U copy at
multiplicity h_j on (a,b), a<m,b<h_j. The complement b>=h_j remains complete.
At U paid rank r, its owner requests a<r,b<h_j after the paid normalizers.
Invoke V at multiplicity r on the j-indexed distinct physical owner fields,
with ambient a<r,b<n; its target h_j is the same requested rectangle.
The orders (a,b) and (b,a) differ by an explicit finite permutation, charged
by section 2. The canonical rank operator is a tensor of identical kernels,
so reordering factors leaves the requested operator unchanged. Complete V,
restore each field's prior order and both normalizers, then resume U.
The V ambient fits because r<=m. Its use of b>=h_j assumes no zeros there:
these are arbitrary spectators returned unchanged. Final role (i,j) acts on
a<k_i,b<h_j, canonicalized by section 2 to its first k_i*h_j coordinates.
Induction gives ambient m*n and handles every finite product. Different paid
positions are never combined, and each route is undone before resumption.

**Completion.** Canonicalize each complete product endpoint on its own field.
For K<L<=m_product append the positive job on [K,L). It and the old job on
[0,K) give G_L. Both intervals are inside the original complete rectangle;
no array or productive input is added. This happens after every product child
has returned, with whole-job normalizers around the complete old word.

**Splitting.** Replace canonical paid rank R by consecutive disjoint lists
[0,J),[J,2J),... and its exact remainder. Route each list by section 2 and
restore it before the next piece. Keep the original normalizers around the
complete replacement. Disjoint tensor factors give G_R. This applies to
original and completion jobs, with their actual owner unchanged.

**Integer compiler.** The integer flow lists unit occurrences, roles, paid
rounds, source deficits and deepest exits. Use its actual Pascal matching,
with a deterministic lexicographic order within equal-rank buckets. Each unit
at column c has m*c<=N. A child role of rank k*c matched to a parent requested
ordered list A of that length uses section 2 to extend A to its full m*c
ambient. Before executing the class, pre-route every distinct physical field
into the common canonical N-coordinate order. Run the *complete* native unit
there, including scalar contacts. Then inverse-route every field. This is
essential: changing per-role supports inside an unchanged scalar word would
not align its ADD operations. Conjugating complete fields makes all intermediate
addresses aligned and preserves every incoming spectator on return.

Source deficits receive distinct actual top-level arrays, not copied inputs.
Owned fields are full N-coordinate arrays with separate path names. Execute
classes lockstep and restore all role orders before a parent resumes. Thus
this algorithm derives occurrence injections from the finite matching; it
does not require an external list of arbitrary injections.

For a source rank s the preliminary smaller program acts on [s,N), followed
by the source job on [0,s). An exit rank e uses its already constructed
uniform program on the exit's ordered A and complete complement. Its recipes
substitute through the same full-field conjugation. Smaller ranks give the
source induction and base termination; we do not reprove the source's rank
termination estimates. The actual clearing factor a is divisible by every
needed smaller width, so complete batches give the role bijections. Whole-field
role permutations, scans and inverse permutations remain separately charged;
a swap can use three ADDs and a sign under the source same-chart contract.

Induction on products and compiler rank gives an actual injection, full
complement and inverse return route at every emitted occurrence. The map may
depend on role and current owner. One map per syntactic raw node is insufficient.
The per-occurrence movement bound of section 2 is explicit; this package does
not evaluate the astronomical number of occurrences or a complete total bill.
Re-emitted adapters can increase finite ordinary and descriptor/setup constants.
Finiteness does not certify the selected raw 10^9 allowance or any numerical
finite tariff; a final caller must substitute and pay the actual new counts.

## 4. Final N/W/O reservations and whole-row stock

Let the finite uniform template have actual rank N>=2, productive width W>=1
and conservative owned inventory O>=0. These are finite compiler outputs,
not raw counts. Fix integers p,d,K,G,f,D with 1<=f, 1<=D<=d<=p and N*f<=D;
also require K,G>=1; put H=dG. Let L be the smallest integer with N^L>=2d. For any independent
simultaneous stock S_other>=1 define

    P_stock = [W*(O+1)]^L * S_other,
    q0 = max(1, ceil(ceil(log2(P_stock))/K)),
    qF = ceil(2H/K), qB = ceil(H/K),
    o = (q0+qF+lead)*K, z=(D-qB)*K, lead>=0.

Require o+N*f*K<=z. The complete placement is

    phi(a,j,rho)=o+(a*f+j)*K+rho
    (0<=a<N, 0<=j<f, 0<=rho<K).

The two full H-bit front fields end by o; the full H-bit back field starts
at z. No row/control bit enters an occurrence map. Section 3 permutes only
N base blocks, preserving this separation. A primitive of c*f columns has
c*f<=N*f<=d, hence (c*f-1)G<=H and c*f<=p. The remaining compact domain
G=4*ceil(log2 p)+6, A=O(p), K>=G+4*ceil(log2 p)+10 and the
record-fiber condition are explicit retained premises. COST.md verifies this
sufficient guard directly in the compact proof, including K=128G in the
selected deferred schedule. K/log p tending to infinity is a stronger
sufficient regime, not needed after the guard is supplied. Interval placement
alone does not prove the tariff.
When the fit inequality fails the source individual-kernel fallback applies;
it is outside this invocation theorem.

The stock covers the source-style discipline of at most L ordinary recursion
levels, at each level a whole-row factor W and optional private/parking factor
O+1, returned before reuse; independent simultaneous schedules use S_other.
More generally the product of actual unreleased divisors on every path must
divide P_stock. An extra unreleased divisor can violate this condition even if that
divisor is individually at most W or O+1; it is permitted only when the new
complete path product still divides P_stock. This is divisibility, not a size
comparison. No dispatcher implementation is certified. Owned initialized
backing remains separately admitted: reserving O+1 row labels does not turn
arbitrary productive rows into erased scratch and gives no extra output credit.

The initial row range R=2^(q0*K) is at least P_stock. Pad once to the next
multiple R', so R<=R'<R+P_stock<=2R. Each row includes the full front fields,
active rectangle, back field, all spectators and record suffix. A legal split
u=b*g+w is a bijection on whole rows and each role receives the same complete
within-row rectangle. Its remaining row count is divisible by the unconsumed
path stock. Return reconstructs u=b*g+w in reverse nesting order. The quotient
never contains a control bit. After padding, the row range need not have a
power-of-two size. The descriptor is the pair (row index, within-row fields):
phi uses the unchanged within-row offset o-q0*K, not a proposed binary bit
offset following a new row-index encoding. All full control fields retain
their original lengths and order. Independent simultaneous stocks cannot be
replaced by their maximum: 2 and 3 each divide a number only when their
least common multiple divides it, while the source's safe product is 6;
taking max(2,3)=3 does not suffice for both.

Each primitive restores its full borrowed controls before scalar contacts,
children and return. Each wrapper restores spectators and parent descriptors.
These are inherited primitive/native endpoints propagated by the proved
composition, not consequences of address cardinality alone. Deleting padded
zero rows still requires the complete linear endpoint to return them to zero.
W and O must be final-template values, never raw 13,444 or local 29/31/13.

## 5. Compiler implication and scope

Together with COST.md, the geometry gives a source-compatible finite-word
construction at the retained ordinary node tariff, conditional on native
all-column whole-job endpoints, owned initialization/erasure and the admitted
physical/precision contracts. Finiteness of an explicitly defined construction
does not require materializing or executing the enormous winning template.
Nonmaterialization alone is therefore not a mathematical gap.

The quantified integer-flow theorem remains an imported dependency here.
FINITE-PRECOMPILATION sections3--6 provide its Pascal matching, source deficits,
ordered complete-batch clearance and strict smaller-rank substitution; the
lockstep source supplies distinct-field ownership and return chronology.
Together with p7-TENSOR's product/completion/splitting semantics and the actual
selected canonical raw ABI, those retained theorems imply the complex compiler
closure under the other stated premises. This package has not independently
re-audited every quantified statement in that dependency chain. It neither
identifies a new remaining incompatibility nor certifies removal of the
selected compiler assumption. The unexecuted emitter is an implementation and
independent validation boundary, not a replacement for a missing existence
proof. All five selected assumptions remain in the record.


The written theorem constructs geometry for every finite instance of the named
source compiler under its semantic and ownership premises. Its all-f force
comes from the argument. Tests use all 112 retained phase recipes (a superset
of the selected 104 ports), complete actual controller target/IDLE supports,
compressed canonicalizers and inverses, product placements, nested returns
and interval/stock boundaries. Sources are SHA256-bound before parsing; no
predecessor executable is imported. See README and the independent review for
exact executed coverage; not every universal induction is a finite fixture.

The final selected matching, occurrence counts, numerical program, descriptor
producer, row dispatcher and precision/error contracts are not materialized
or executed. Primitive correctness, local all-column semantics, owned erasure,
complete physical/stock/precision closure and analytic recovery remain
premises. COST.md proves the narrower symbolic ordinary node-tariff closure
under its explicit primitive and current-volume contracts; that is separate
from rounded numerical and complete machine admission. This is not a proof of the entire native_all_columns or compiler
assumption, a complete multiplication theorem, or a change to kappa.
